title: Nick Pope's death from cancer

tellings.quote: Elizabeth [snorts] um Weiss her you know her husband Nick Pope um died of cancer just a couple

plain: Nick Pope, a British figure well known for talking about UFOs, died of cancer just a short while ago, according to the skeptic Michael Shermer, who mentions it in passing during a debate with the host. Shermer brings it up while speaking of Pope's wife, a woman named Elizabeth Weiss, and names no source for it.
